_note: Limits the agent harness imposes on what an agent can read, measured from the installed extension (#341). Read by _long_lines.py; referenced by the ado-shared and ado-workitem skills. test-long-line-guard.ps1 D1 compares the two values against the installed extension wherever one exists.

measured.extension: GitHub Copilot Chat bundled with VS Code build 2242ebbb54
measured.evidence: dist/extension.js and package.json of that build; probe file with a 3,011-character line

spill_threshold_chars.source: setting github.copilot.chat.agent.largeToolResultsToDisk.thresholdBytes (compared against the result's string length)
spill_threshold_chars.applies_to: text tool results (MCP, terminal); not read_file, not search/explore/execution subagents, not memory
spill_threshold_chars.effect: the model receives only a path; the result is written to content.json (pretty-printed when it parses as JSON) or content.txt
spill_threshold_chars.workaround: narrow the call so the result stays under the threshold, e.g. wit_work_item get with fields instead of expand All

spill_enabled.effect: switches the spill on or off
spill_enabled.workaround: leave on: without it every large result lands in context in full

read_file_line_chars.applies_to: every line read_file returns, including spilled tool results
read_file_line_chars.effect: a longer line is cut and marked [truncated]; paging does not help, a line cannot be paged
read_file_line_chars.workaround: read the lossless copy the PostToolUse hook names, or parse the file in the terminal

read_file_lines_per_call.source: hardcoded in read_file (offset/limit form; startLine/endLine is not capped)
read_file_lines_per_call.effect: a large file is read in several calls
read_file_lines_per_call.workaround: page with further calls; lossless for ordinary line lengths
